استفحلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْحَلُوا (istafḥalū) /is.taf.ħa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# اِسْتَفْحِلُوا (istafḥilū) /is.taf.ħi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
